title: Solar energy and storage
text: Solar photovoltaic panels convert light into electricity. Battery storage can shift energy from sunny periods to evening demand. A research answer should compare conversion efficiency, storage duration, cost, and local grid constraints rather than treating one metric as decisive.

title: Safe drinking-water research
text: Water safety depends on source quality, treatment, storage, and testing. Boiling can inactivate many pathogens but does not remove dissolved metals. Filtration performance depends on pore size and media, so claims should cite the contaminant and treatment mechanism.

title: Comparing conflicting evidence
text: When sources conflict, compare publication date, methodology, sample size, uncertainty, and incentives. Separate direct observations from interpretation. A synthesis should preserve disagreement, cite each claim, and explain why one source may be more applicable to the question.

title: Why Earth has seasons
text: Earth's seasons are caused primarily by its roughly 23.5-degree axial tilt. A hemisphere tilted toward the Sun receives more direct sunlight and longer days, while the opposite hemisphere receives less direct sunlight and has shorter days. The hemispheres therefore have opposite seasons at the same time, which would not happen if changing Earth-Sun distance were the main cause. Earth is also closest to the Sun in early January, during Northern Hemisphere winter.
